title: A Perfect Soup Dumpling Has Exactly 18 Folds | China Travel Expert
description:
The world's most celebrated soup dumpling follows a "golden ratio": exactly 18 folds, 21 grams, and a wrapper thinner than 2.5 mm. That's 16 grams of filling to 5 grams of dough, sealed by hand so the hot soup stays trapped inside until you bite.

Xiaolongbao is a Shanghai-region classic — steamed in stacked bamboo baskets and eaten in one careful, soupy bite.

🧭 Expert Tip: In Shanghai, xiaolongbao is the signature bite — go early in the day; the best houses sell out.

一只完美的小笼包:正好18个褶、21克重、皮薄不到2.5毫米——16克馅配5克面,手工收口锁住滚烫汤汁。上海是小笼包的老家。
